question: Which of the following festivals is also known as 'peerla panduga'?
solution: The correct answer is __**Muharam**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Muharram, also called Peerla Panduga is an important festival in the state of Telangana. • Muharram is a festival marked by processions. • During this occasion, a relic called Alam is taken out as a procession. • Ashurkhana, representing a group of Sufi Shrines, is the area where the procession takes place, Many Muslims and even Hindus take part in this festival by chanting Ya Hussain as they participate eagerly in this procession. • On the last day in Hyderabad, the Peerlu (Alamrelic) is carried on top of an elephant and taken in procession from Bibi ka Alam to Chaderghat.
